additional_info.subject: ID0386874-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / S2 170003316] Outlets out of order CRM:01811000411
additional_info.body:
Hello Jessica,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Ankita
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / S2 170003316
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
bo9lyk
Problem Description
: Outlets out of order
We reviewed the logs and determined that the outlets are going out of order due to a COAP polling error.
COAP error you’ve encountered is due to a  interruption in internal communication between the Si-D and the SECC. Please rest assured that this is a temporary issue, and the Si-D will automatically reconnect to the SECC within approximately 5 seconds.
During this period when the SECC is unreachable, you may see an "Outlet out of order" flag. This is a normal indication that the system is not currently connected, but this status will be cleared as soon as the connection is reestablished. Additionally, you might notice a "preparing" status displayed in the HMI occasionally, which is also part of the normal recovery process.
If you have any further questions or need additional assistance, please feel free to reach out.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0386874
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
